name: Vernigo
tagline: You can build filters, bookmarks, and an outlier score over a small set of YouTube channels, but Vernigo's product is the continuously refreshed corpus: millions of videos, channel baselines, niche-level supply and demand signals, and ranking data improved by how thousands of users interact with the library. A one-shot app can reproduce the interface and formula, not the dataset that makes the results useful.
